title: 第7章 疾风魔狼
slug: 魔兽剑圣异界纵横全本免费-魔兽剑圣异界纵横最新章节列表
content_zh:
经过短暂的谈话，各队也开始了短暂的合作。
收拾好各自东西，队伍汇集在一起，继续向死亡森林开拨而进。
看着已经严重缩水的队伍，刘枫也不禁在心中为死亡森林的凶险而惊叹，刚来时候那可是好几千人的庞大队伍啊，现在呢。。只剩千多点人了，而且这还只是森林的中部啊，最为凶险的深处都还没进去。
况且，还有最后的终极BOSS，黑龙。
虽然说是生产之后，实力骤降到九阶，但是人家那身板摆在那儿在啊，瘦死的骆驼还比马大呢。
黑龙，火系魔法绝对免疫，其它系魔法大部分免疫，物理防御极强。
暗自摇头，心中对他们这次的夺取龙蛋的任务，根本没有任何的信心，就算是那三位隐藏在暗处的九阶星辰阶强者也不行。
大队人马极其小心的在森林之中，摸索前进，不敢发出太大的声响，害怕声音一大，又引来那些残暴凶恶的高阶魔兽。
整个森林之中，除了晰晰梭梭的脚步声，竟无一点说话之声。
刘枫和苏菲陪着霍暴俩兄弟以及那些领队的队长，走在整个队伍的中间。
被这死寂的气氛憋得气闷不已的苏菲，刚想开口说话，却被刘枫的眼神给制止了下来，只好撅着小嘴，把心中怒火发泄在路边的花花草草之上，在心中不断的臭骂。
“臭刘枫，死刘枫，真是个讨厌鬼。”
*************
“大人，不好了，前面发现有魔兽冲过来了。”
一声急喝声，打破了行军中的宁静。
看着报信之人满身的鲜血，想来他们和魔兽已经初步相遇了。
“哪种魔兽，阶级多少？”罕马与澜柯齐声喝道。
“大人，是魔狼，七阶疾风魔狼。”
众多领队闻言也是悄悄松了口气，七阶魔兽，虽然难缠，不过并不是不能对付。
“不过。。不过。它们有五十多条。”

刚刚松了一口气的领队们，又被这句话给把那口气给打了出来。
“我靠，你TM的就不能一口气说完吗？混蛋。”
脾气最为火暴的格斗工会长老狂战怒吼道，这种说一半留一半的说话方式，最让人恼火不已了。
这名报信的小卒子，在狂战的怒火之下，吓得战战兢兢的一句话也不敢回。
“好了，狂战长老，现在不是责怪人的时候，还是展开队行，准备和魔狼战斗吧。”澜柯轻笑着出言制止了怒火冲天的狂战。
“列队。”
随着一声大喝，保持前进的队形立刻转变成了防守的阵形。
虽然各大队伍第一次合作，但是带出来的人都是各自的精锐队伍，凭借良好的经验，摆出一个防守阵形并不困难。
一场撕杀在所难免。
霍暴回转头来，对刘枫他们轻声道：“注意戒备，五十多头七阶魔兽啊，看来这次又有一场血战了。”
轻轻点了点头，把有些兴奋的苏菲一把拉到身后。
**************
看着眼前的大群魔狼，刘枫皱了皱眉头，的确有场大战了。
领头的一只头顶略带点银色的魔狼，抬出丑陋的狼头，血红的大眼里，杀气弥漫。
仰头朝天一声长哮，带着大批魔狼疾冲向摆好防御的大队人马。
越来越进，最前面的一位骑士都已闻到了那狼口中的腥臭，斗气聚集在长枪之上，泛着淡黄的颜色。
“光明神，于吾同在。”
看着疾刺而来的长枪，领头银狼，眼中闪过一丝不屑，前抓轻舞，一阵紫色的风卷带着巨大的力量将精钢打造的铁枪，砍断成几截，去势任然不停，连带着将骑士也卷砍成几段。
人与兽的交战，鲜血残肢不断挥舞。
刘枫手中铁剑，疾削向一头魔狼，坚韧的狼皮在锋利的剑罡之下，如同薄纸一般，轻易的被一削而断。

人影一闪，躲开了那漫天鲜血，又挥剑攻向另一头横冲直撞的魔狼。
另一边。
银色魔狼一上来，就被怒火冲天的狂战阻拦住，深红的斗气布满双拳，拳头上的拳套也在斗气的灌入下变得深红起来，拳套之上的尖刺泛着幽青的光芒。
重重的拳，没有任何技巧，只有力量，绝对的力量。
深红的拳头带着极强的压迫性，轰向银狼的头颅。
银狼虽然力量不如狂战，可灵巧与敏捷也胜过他许多。
闪开一拳，双抓连续挥舞，紫色的风卷就似不需要魔力一般，连绵不断的攻向狂战。

content_en:
After a short conversation, the teams also began a short period of cooperation.
After packing up their belongings, the team gathered together and continued towards the Death Forest.
Looking at the severely reduced team, Liu Feng couldn't help but marvel at the danger of the Death Forest. When he first arrived, it was a huge team of several thousand people, and now. . There are only a few thousand people left, and this is only the middle of the forest. The most dangerous depths have not yet been entered.
Moreover, there is also the final ultimate BOSS, the Black Dragon.
Although it is said that her strength dropped to the ninth level after giving birth, her body is there. A skinny camel is bigger than a horse.
The black dragon is absolutely immune to fire magic and most other magics, and has extremely strong physical defense.
Shaking his head secretly, he didn't have any confidence in their mission to seize the dragon egg this time, not even the three ninth-level star-level experts hiding in the dark.
The large group of people groped forward in the forest with extreme caution, not daring to make too much noise for fear that the loud noise would attract those cruel and ferocious high-level monsters.
In the entire forest, except for the clear sound of footsteps, there was no sound of any voice.
Liu Feng and Sophie walked in the middle of the entire team, accompanying the Huo Bao brothers and the team captains.
Sophie, who was suffocated by the dead silence, was about to speak, but was stopped by Liu Feng's eyes. She had no choice but to pout her mouth and vent her anger on the flowers and plants on the roadside, constantly cursing in her heart.
"Stupid Liu Feng, damn Liu Feng, what a nuisance."
*************
"Sir, it's not good, there is a monster coming from the front."
A sharp shout broke the silence of the march.
Looking at the blood all over the body of the messenger, it seemed that they had already had a preliminary encounter with the monster.
"What kind of monster and what level is it?" Hanma and Lanke shouted in unison.
"Sir, this is a demon wolf, a seventh-level wind demon wolf."
Many team leaders secretly breathed a sigh of relief when they heard this. Although the seventh-level monsters were difficult to deal with, they were not impossible to deal with.
"But...but. There are more than fifty of them."
The team leaders who had just breathed a sigh of relief were relieved by these words.
"Holy shit, couldn't you just finish it in one go? Asshole."
Kuizhan, the most fiery-tempered elder of the Fighting Guild, roared, "This kind of half-talking and half-leaving way of speaking is the most irritating."
The little pawn who reported the news was so frightened that he did not dare to reply a word under the fury of the mad battle.
"Alright, Elder Kuangzhan, now is not the time to blame others. Let's start the team and prepare to fight the demon wolf." Lanke chuckled and stopped the furious Kuangzhan.
"Line up."
With a loud shout, the advancing formation immediately changed to a defensive formation.
Although the major teams are cooperating for the first time, the people brought out are all elite teams of their own. With good experience, it is not difficult to set up a defensive formation.
A fight is inevitable.
Huo Bao turned around and whispered to Liu Feng and the others: "Be careful, there are more than fifty seventh-level monsters. It seems that there will be another bloody battle this time."
He nodded slightly and pulled the somewhat excited Sophie behind him.
****************
Looking at the large group of demon wolves in front of him, Liu Feng frowned. There was indeed a battle.
The leader, a demon wolf with a slight silvery head, raised its ugly wolf head, and its big blood-red eyes were filled with murderous intent.
He raised his head to the sky and let out a long roar, leading a large number of demon wolves towards the large group of people who had set up defense.
As they advanced further and further, the knight at the front could smell the fishy stench from the wolf's mouth, and fighting energy gathered on the spear, glowing with a light yellow color.
"The God of Light is with me."
Looking at the spear that was stabbing quickly, the leading silver wolf flashed in his eyesWith a trace of disdain, he lightly danced forward, and a burst of purple wind brought huge power and cut the iron gun made of fine steel into several pieces. The castration continued, and also cut the knight into several pieces.
In the battle between man and beast, bloody limbs are constantly waving.
The iron sword in Liu Feng's hand was slashed at a demonic wolf. The tough wolf skin was easily cut off like tissue paper under the sharp blade.
The figure dodged away from the blood that filled the sky, and then swung his sword to attack the other rampaging demon wolf.
other side.
As soon as the silver demon wolf came up, he was blocked by the furious battle. Deep red fighting spirit filled his fists. The gloves on his fists also turned crimson as the fighting spirit poured into them. The spikes on the gloves glowed with a faint green light.
Heavy punches, no skills, just power, absolute power.
The crimson fist struck Silver Wolf's head with great pressure.
Although Silver Wolf is not as powerful as Kuang Zhan, his dexterity and agility are much better than his.
Dodging a punch and swinging his hands continuously, the purple wind scroll continued to attack Kuang Zhan as if it didn't need any magic power.
